experiment: Four complete migration paths per data arm, two separate candidate blocks.
scope: Retrospective selection pilot with experiment-held-out oxide materials from the source Train split. Initial structures/BVSE only at freeze. Independence from foundation pretraining is unverified. The original Test and previous four sealed materials are not scored. The source Test is not added to training.

candidates.rule: Highest BVSE forward barrier within each slot, set before DFT labels. This is a frozen simple comparator, not a claim of predictive validity.
candidates.random: Uniform independently among all eligible candidates in each slot with the recorded seed. Shared selections stay in both arms without redraw.

matched_cost.boundary: Each arm matches exact atom counts and exact image counts within slots. Historical actual DFT core-hours and same-cost prospective evidence are unavailable. Composition may differ within a stratum.

geometry_rule: Existing periodic Init matcher at 0.03 angstrom displacement and 0.5% lattice strain; includes prior and shortlisted materials. Exact composition and atom-count matching do not rule out duplicate supercell multiples.

recipe.optimizer: torch.optim.Adam defaults plus the recorded learning rate

measurements.sign: A=error(augmented)-error(D0), negative favors the data arm. S=error(random)-error(BVSE), positive favors BVSE.
measurements.target: Forward migration barrier MAE at the frozen DFT reference images.
measurements.interval: Within each cohort resample materials with aligned D0/random/BVSE and average across fixed paired seeds. Report each seed, point estimate, and 95% material interval.
measurements.gate: First require absolute improvement against D0 in both candidate blocks, each with upper 95% bound below -0.25 meV and three negative seed effects. A rule advantage requires the paired rule-vs-random lower interval above +0.25 meV in both blocks and three positive seed effects, plus absolute benefit of the rule arm. Otherwise result remains exploratory/inconclusive. No adaptive switch of candidates, rule, or panel.
